extensionName.message: Chat Exporter for Microsoft Teams — Files & ZIP

extensionDescription.message: Export Microsoft Teams chats with messages, images, accessible files and links to a private ZIP. Runs locally; no admin access.

actionTitle.message: Export current Teams chat to ZIP

checkingDetail.message: Looking for an open Teams conversation…

disclosureDetail.message: Review how the extension handles the open conversation.

disclosureText.message: The extension reads the open conversation and accessible file links to create an archive on this device. Nothing is sent to the developer.

localOnly.message: Processed locally. Nothing is sent to us.

openChatDetail.message: Open a personal or group chat in Microsoft Teams, then try again.

exportStartingDetail.message: Follow progress in the Teams tab.

errorGeneric.message: Reload the Teams tab and try again.

errorInjectionFailed.message: The exporter could not be injected. Reload the Teams tab and try again.

statusKeepTabOpen.message: Keep this Teams tab open until the archive is ready.

statusCancelled.message: No partial ZIP was created. Start the export again to retry.

errorUnsupportedPage.message: Open teams.cloud.microsoft or teams.microsoft.com and select a chat first.

errorChatNotFound.message: No messages were found. Open a personal or group chat and try again.

errorScrollerNotFound.message: The message list could not be found. Make sure a chat—not the Files tab—is open.

errorAlreadyRunning.message: An export is already running in this tab.

errorCaptureLimit.message: The history limit was reached before the beginning of the chat could be confirmed. No partial ZIP was created.

errorZipBuild.message: The ZIP could not be created. Reduce attachment size or retry without files.

errorDownload.message: The browser could not start the ZIP download. Use the Download ZIP button in the progress panel.
